title: No live system was reachable; the plan rests on files, the operator's log and vendor pages
rationale: This cloud session had the repositories, the uploaded execution log and web access. The gateway connector failed to connect and there was no Mac, phone or glasses. Every statement about the fabric is from the log of 2026-11-17 to 11-19 and is unverified until M0-04
closes_on: M0-03 and M0-04 report from a lane with a shell on the Mac
not_touched: No machine, service, account or shared config

title: The fork's main cannot build from a fresh clone and is nine SDK releases behind
rationale: Secrets.swift is a compiled source but ignored; Package.resolved is absent and hidden by a workspace ignore rule; the WebRTC package is referenced twice; the tests import a module no target links; bundle id and team are the upstream author's; the SDK pin is 0.4.0 against a current 1.1.0. Read in the project file, never compiled
closes_on: M0-10 compiles the chosen baseline on the Mac

title: Upstream VisionClaw is the newer app, and every model and task call in it goes to a vendor cloud
rationale: At 3f39807 upstream pins SDK 0.9.0, has a shared scheme, the still-photo call, Siri and Action Button intents, earcons and the glasses audio-route handling. It depends on LiveKit Cloud, Gemini Live or OpenAI Realtime, Anthropic Managed Agents and Browser Use Cloud, and its gateway answers tool confirmations with allow automatically. Its only licence file is Meta's developer terms

title: Ten decisions are proposed, led by building on upstream on a new branch and leaving main alone
rationale: D-01 baseline is upstream on branch sovereign; D-02 a turn is one request; D-03 a small gateway on the Mac in front of LiteLLM; D-04 speech on the phone first; D-05 Xcode Cloud to TestFlight internal with a local fallback; D-06 wake strategy by measurement; D-07 safety tiers in gateway code; D-08 package in the repository with a vault pointer; D-09 iOS only; D-10 private build. Each has a default and an undo in the plan
rollback: Each decision's undo line; D-01 is undone by deleting the sovereign branch
closes_on: M0-01: a gate line per decision quoting the operator
human_held: Ratify or amend D-01 to D-10 (M0-01)

quality.basis: reasoned from read evidence; no measurement yet

title: The log and the infrastructure map both say the Mac Studio has 256 GB; the request said 512
rationale: The execution log calls it a 256 GB machine and sets the GPU wired limit to 245760 MB; every component title in the uploaded infrastructure map says Mac Studio 256GB. Nothing supports 512 GB. The vault repository also describes an earlier install under a different user whose tailnet node is offline
human_held: O-1: is the Mac 256 GB or 512 GB, or are there two Macs
O-3: confirm the m3u install with LiteLLM on :4000 is the live fabric

title: Nothing on the fabric is reachable from a phone, and no image has been sent through LiteLLM
rationale: LiteLLM listens on 127.0.0.1:4000 and Tailscale Serve publishes only the password vault. Vision was proven on the model backends by a test harness; no image request through :4000 is recorded. There is no speech-to-text service on this install. The design assumes image and tool calls work through LiteLLM, so this is the first thing to test
followups: Run M0-04 before any gateway code is written

title: Meta's SDK is at 1.1.0 with a glasses-side launch phrase; publishing is closed but TestFlight internal works
rationale: Vendor pages read on 2026-11-20 say 1.0.0 added Hey Meta start app-name, capture-button events, on-glasses speech and a standalone still as experimental features; the current SDK needs Xcode 26.4 and iOS 17.2; the glasses microphone exists only on the hands-free profile; App Store publishing has no date. One researcher, not yet used in a build
closes_on: M0-12 and M0-13 on the real device

title: The program package is written: plan, task board, resources, work order and a ledger tool
rationale: docs/program holds the plan with acceptance for every task through M4, a 48-task board, the resources list, the one-shot work order for Duet and a post-clone script template. tools/program/ledger.py appends, validates and renders this record and refuses lines without evidence, out-of-order lines and credential-shaped text. The tool was exercised end to end in a scratch copy, including its refusal cases
rollback: Delete docs/program, docs/architecture and tools/program; nothing else was changed
not_touched: Existing source, docs and the fork's main

quality.basis: files written and the tool run in this session

title: The architecture map exists as two models and a hand-drawn preview; Archify did not run
rationale: base.json is the system as found and head.json is the target, both in Archify's architecture format with stable ids. The Archify command was blocked in this session, so the Before, Delta and After page was drawn from the same two files by a throwaway script and looked at once in a headless browser in dark and light. It has no validate, deliver, check or browser-check receipt
closes_on: M0-15: Archify finalize and compare on the Mac, preview deleted

quality.basis: one visual look; no automated gates

title: The intended cross-checking pass did not run, so web claims rest on one researcher each
rationale: The multi-agent workflow and one research agent were blocked by this session's permission classifier. Five single-researcher passes ran instead and I read upstream, Archify and the cited code lines myself. Anything marked web in the plan is a lead to confirm at the task that depends on it
